steps.what: Specify datasets, sample identities, genome versions and compilation mappings
Compile data files and apply the specified identifiers, formats and joins
Reconcile compiled data and resolve sample, assembly or annotation mismatches

tasks.design: Configure versioned compilation in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a scientist-checked manifest. Keep biological identifiers, source suitability and reconciliation with the scientist rather than inferring mappings automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeat file gathering, format conversion and fixed joins can require manual setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned pipelines can repeat explicit mappings and emit reconciliation exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Sample identity, reference assemblies and incompatible annotation meanings.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing whether technically joinable data are biologically comparable.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeat assembly while retaining responsibility for dataset meaning.

reach.learn: Sample identity and assay metadata conventions

evidence.claim: nf-core provides versioned bioinformatics pipelines with containers and tests, supporting reproducible processing rather than autonomous scientific interpretation.
The specific compilation workflow and saving are unmeasured assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary covers dataset compilation, excluding original experiments, source collection and downstream biological inference.

Scientist produces dataset versions, sample IDs, reference assembly, annotation version, units, join keys and permitted transformations in s1, including metadata checking and capture. Missing source metadata requires retained investigation; no new technician entry task is assumed.
Test existing pipeline configuration before custom code. Unresolved identity or assembly mismatches stop compilation for manual reconciliation in s3.
Only repeated human file and mapping setup is removed; existing pipeline runtime and automatic joins earn no new saving.
unknowns: Sample metadata completeness and source compatibility
research_questions: How much repeat compilation setup remains after metadata checking and reconciliation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65, gross35 minus focal upkeep10 gives net25. Range allows source incompatibility and existing automation to consume most or all benefit; biological reconciliation remains counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select research results, verified figures, limitations and references for the intended audience
Prepare scientific publications, project reports or conference presentation drafts

loop.purpose: Draft communication from the supplied findings
loop.input: Verified figures, findings, limitations, references and audience brief
loop.output: Draft text with explicit result and reference links
loop.check: Scientist checks every claim, number and citation against the result pack and verifies that uncertainty is preserved
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims are removed or rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining findings to different audiences requires contextual prose beyond a fixed report layout

steps.what: Validate scientific claims, approve the communication and present or submit the final version

tasks.design: Draft narrative sections in {DOCS} from a scientist-selected result pack. Keep scientific interpretation, coauthor coordination, final approval and live presentation fully human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing audience-appropriate narrative takes time after results are settled.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can restate supplied findings with explicit source links.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding overstated biological conclusions and answering scientific challenges.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the research's significance and limitations.
tasks.altitude: A limited writing gain leaves research claims and publication responsibility unchanged.

reach.task: Explain computational findings in scientific context

evidence.claim: Benchling AI drafts study reports; this supports report drafting capability, not the proposed time coefficient or scientific correctness.

assumptions: Boundary covers communicating completed research, excluding generating analytical results and independent peer review.

Scientist produces result IDs, figure versions, approved claims, limitations, reference identifiers and audience constraints in s1, including capture and verification time. Missing evidence means manual writing; no invented citation is accepted.
Test native templates and approved drafting first. Coauthor and institutional approval work stays in the existing process; no automatic submission is proposed.
Live presentation, questions and scientific validation retain their full time.
research_questions: Does checked narrative drafting save time after source tracing and coauthor corrections?

incremental.description: Source restrictions and drafting template maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Final text, figures, references, limitations and communication destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross9 minus focal upkeep5 gives net4. Range allows complex claims and substantial revisions; live presentation and scientific validation remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify bioinformatics test datasets, expected outcomes, tolerances and relevant failure cases
Run repeated software tests and collect comparisons against specified reference outputs
Interpret test failures and judge the updated tool's scientific suitability

tasks.design: Configure repeat test execution and comparison reports in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist defines scientifically meaningful fixtures and interprets discrepancies before deciding whether an update is suitable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Re-running established test cases and assembling comparisons can require manual orchestration.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned tests and fixtures can run through a reproducible harness.
tasks.still_hard: Coverage gaps, numerical differences and biological meaning of changed outputs.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when passing tests fail to establish suitability for a new use.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated test orchestration and focus on coverage and unexplained changes.

reach.task: Identify representative assay edge cases for tests
reach.learn: Assay failure modes and metadata variation

evidence.claim: nf-core pipelines include tagged releases, containers and tests, supporting reproducible bioinformatics test execution.

assumptions: Boundary covers tool and update testing, excluding development of new algorithms and production research analysis.

Scientist produces release ID, fixture versions, expected outputs, tolerances and failure criteria in s1, including fixture capture. Test expectations come from independent validated references rather than the software under test.
Test native test frameworks first. Unspecified expectations, changed formats or unexplained differences return to expert investigation in s3.
Savings remove human repeated orchestration and report assembly only; existing automated tests and computer runtime earn no new saving.
research_questions: How much manual test orchestration remains after coverage design and scientific failure review?

already_counted.description: Scientific failure interpretation and suitability judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross25 minus focal upkeep8 gives net17. Range allows existing automation and changing tool interfaces to absorb most benefit; scientific review remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design bioinformatics algorithms and define biological objectives, assumptions and validation requirements
Implement the specified algorithms for application to biological data

loop.purpose: Draft implementation code for a scientist-selected algorithm
loop.input: Explicit algorithm specification, permitted libraries and synthetic fixtures
loop.output: Candidate implementation with assumptions and dependency list
loop.check: Scientist inspects mathematical correspondence, leakage risks and biological identifiers, then compares against independent reference results
loop.stop: One draft and one repair; unexplained behaviour returns to manual implementation
loop.why_not_simpler: Nonstandard implementation requires contextual code construction rather than a fixed parameter template

steps.what: Validate algorithm behaviour and apply the accepted implementation to authorized research data

tasks.design: Use validated libraries in {DATA_PLATFORM} before considering drafted code. A bounded helper can implement a scientist-owned specification, while algorithm selection, independent validation and research application remain human responsibilities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementing a settled algorithm can require repetitive code construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded code drafting can create a candidate implementation for expert verification.
tasks.still_hard: Biological validity, data leakage and generalisation beyond test data.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing whether the algorithm answers the scientific question.
tasks.altitude: Retain scientific authority with a small potential reduction in implementation effort.

reach.learn: Statistical evaluation and independent test design

evidence.claim: Bounded implementation drafting may assist coding, but these time assumptions do not demonstrate biological correctness or measured savings.

assumptions: Boundary covers algorithm design, implementation and application; separate testing of third-party updates and routine dataset compilation are excluded.

Scientist produces objective, mathematical rules, input types, identifiers, splits, expected outputs and independent validation fixtures in s1, including capture. Missing specifications require manual development.
Test native validated libraries first. Synthetic fixtures are used for drafting; authorized real data are processed only in the approved research environment.
Any validation work shared with another task is allocated once in roll-ups; no clinical result sign-off or automated external action is proposed.
unknowns: Independent reference results and permitted drafting environment
research_questions: Does code drafting save time after leakage checks and independent biological validation?

incremental.description: Draft restrictions and regression example upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Algorithm specification, code and library versions, validation results and authorized data snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross9 minus focal upkeep6 gives net3. Range allows difficult algorithms and draft repairs; scientific design and validation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains biological interpretation and algorithm decisions while testing reproducible preparation and bounded drafting.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified preparation gains to strengthen reproducibility and biological interpretation.
